name: AdaHGConv (adaptive hypergraph convolution)

whatIsIt.eli5: Pixels send notes to their groups; groups send combined notes back.
whatIsIt.simple: One round of hypergraph message passing: pixels → hyperedges → pixels, with a residual shortcut.
whatIsIt.engineer: A = AdaHyperedgeGen(X) (N×E); He = GELU(Lin(AᵀX)); X' = GELU(Lin(A·He)) + X.

whyExists.eli5: So far-apart pixels in the same group can share knowledge.
whyExists.simple: Two matrix products give every pixel information from all pixels in its groups, at a cost linear in the number of pixels.

eli5: Each group gathers notes from its pixels.
Each pixel gets back notes from its groups.
simple: Hyperedge features = Aᵀ × pixels, then Linear + GELU.
New pixel features = A × hyperedge features, then Linear + GELU.

math: H_e = \mathrm{GELU}(W_e A^\top X),\quad X' = \mathrm{GELU}(W_v A H_e) + X
